# A very long document title that needs an ellipsis in narrow columns

The name of this file is intentionally long. In a three-column layout the
name slot is narrower than the filename, so the row has to trim with an
ellipsis instead of pushing the size and modified time out of the column.

## Checks

- The badge stays `MD`.
- The file name is clipped, not wrapped onto a second line.
- Size and modified time stay right-aligned.

> Hover the row: the hover wash should be clearly visible against the
> column surface, but the name should remain the brightest element.

| Level | Colour |
| --- | --- |
| Name | theme text |
| Modified | about 48% text |
| Size | about 36% text |
